title: Cash Pickup First-Transfer Promotion Terms by Tier
content:
**Annex to the Cash Pickup pricing schedule: first-transfer promotion.**

Each Cash Pickup tier states three things about the first-transfer promotion. The first is whether the transfer fee is waived on the customer's first-ever personal transfer booked on that tier. The second is the largest principal the promotion covers. The third is the margin applied to a first transfer the promotion covers.

| Cash Pickup tier | Transfer fee waived on a first transfer | Largest principal covered (USD) | Margin on a covered first transfer (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cash Pickup Economy | yes | 1000.00 | 0.00 |
| Cash Pickup Express | yes | 500.00 | 0.00 |
| Cash Pickup Express Plus | no | 0.00 (no promotion) | 1.35 |
| Cash Pickup Bank Branch | no | 0.00 (no promotion) | 1.15 |
| Cash Pickup Cardless ATM | no | 0.00 (no promotion) | 1.60 |
| Cash Pickup Large Amount | no | 0.00 (no promotion) | 0.85 |

## Reading the annex

- A largest-principal-covered figure of 0.00 means the tier runs no first-transfer promotion.
- Only Cash Pickup Economy and Cash Pickup Express waive the fee, and only up to 1000.00 and 500.00 of principal respectively.
- On the four tiers without a promotion, the margin column repeats the tier's own margin.
